subject: How to deal with too long and too short branches in a tree

messages.author: d6105ddb77213011
messages.subject: How to deal with too long and too short branches in a tree
parts:
Hello!
Thanks for shearing this so useful package with us!
I am trying to plot a tree which has some branches too short but the branch corresponding to the outgroup is too large. Is there a way to make the outgroup branch smaller without affecting the other branch lengths?
Thank you in advance!

messages.author: b5040293c686adc0
messages.subject: Re: How to deal with too long and too short branches in a tree
parts:
What I do is first generate a tree that has all the important branches clearly shown. This requires you to properly set the dimension of the tree (using xlim) and the size of the PDF export. Then I take that tree to a graphic editing program and I shorten the outgroup branch or any long branches. I put dotted or dashed lines in the middle of that branch to indicate it has been cut. 

If ggtree has a function to cut branch and insert dotted lines in that cut branch, that would be great. 

Guanyang
